VPP for the vpp-offload module: v26.06 (octeon9, bullseye/arm64)

Not bundled here on purpose — the .debs are ~100 MB and change a
couple of times a year, while this bundle rebuilds on every push.
This is the release whose API definitions the binaries in this
bundle were generated against (the CRC handshake at attach
refuses any VPP that disagrees):

  gh release download vpp-v26.06-octeon9-bullseye-arm64 \
    -R unredacted/vpp-unifi -D vpp/

then install per the "Installing on a gateway" section of
unredacted/vpp-unifi's README — NOT a bare dpkg -i. The deb starts its
own service at install AND ships /etc/sysctl.d/80-vpp.conf,
a hugepage sysctl that re-applies on every boot (512 GiB on a
64K-page kernel; it bricked a 64 GB router on 2026-08-21).
The README sequence masks the service, skips the install-time
sysctl, and deletes the shipped file.

Only needed for `module vpp-offload`; the eBPF fast-path needs
nothing from this file. See docs/runbooks/vpp-offload.md.
